requirements.requirement: weekly; ≥3 years and current ICE Sugar No. 11 COT observation
requirements.policy: CFTC public API; exact SUGAR NO. 11 futures-only disaggregated contract

requirements.requirement: weekly current lawful CANE fund shares/AUM and observable listed sugar-ETN issuance or flows
requirements.policy: issuer/sponsor primary holdings and share/notes data only; if lawful history is unavailable mark manual or unavailable, never infer flows from price

requirements.requirement: monthly; ≥30 years of dated ONI history
requirements.policy: NOAA CPC observed ONI only; it cannot substitute for regional weather or a probabilistic outlook

requirements.requirement: daily; ≥3 years for sugar/USD regimes
requirements.policy: reuse one Federal Reserve/FRED semantic series; no commodity-specific clone

requirements.requirement: daily; ≥3 years of producer BRL/INR/THB against USD
requirements.policy: primary central-bank or lawful market history with exact FX bases and roles

requirements.requirement: current front-month ICE Sugar No. 11 quote
requirements.policy: reuse swarm pulse quote transport (`@SB.1`); label US¢/lb futures

requirements.requirement: point-in-time ICE No. 11 close history with source identity
requirements.policy: reuse lawful shared market history for `@SB.1`; continuous back-adjusted futures

requirements.requirement: point-in-time WTI history aligned to sugar
requirements.policy: reuse lawful `@CL.1` history; crude is one ethanol-parity confirmation, not physical cane allocation

requirements.requirement: current No. 11 old/new-crop settlements with ≥3 years of snapshots
requirements.policy: lawful ICE settlements with exact contracts; otherwise unavailable

requirements.requirement: current aligned No. 11/No. 5 white premium net of conversion and freight
requirements.policy: lawful ICE prices with exact contract months and units

requirements.requirement: current Brazil/India/Thailand raw-sugar physical basis aligned by grade, location, unit, FX and contract month
requirements.policy: primary producer/market authority or licensed lawful quotations; otherwise manual or unavailable

requirements.requirement: current ICE No. 11 delivery notices, load-out queue and concentration by delivery point
requirements.policy: lawful ICE delivery notices; preserve report date and contract identity, otherwise unavailable

requirements.requirement: current exchange-deliverable and independently accessible raw-sugar inventory by location
requirements.policy: primary exchange/warehouse/market-authority reports; do not treat national stocks as globally accessible

requirements.requirement: monthly/quarterly; ≥10 years of global balance and accessible stocks-to-use
requirements.policy: USDA/ISO primary releases with country coverage, revisions and inaccessible stocks separated

requirements.requirement: bi-weekly current cane crush, sugar mix and ethanol output
requirements.policy: UNICA primary releases; physical allocation owns the demand/supply split and policy cannot duplicate it

requirements.requirement: current plus ≥30 years of yield-weighted India/Brazil/Thailand weather aligned to crop stage
requirements.policy: primary meteorological observations/forecasts with geography, run time and expiry

requirements.requirement: current cane area, yield, recovery and sugar output by major origin with dispersion
requirements.policy: CONAB/USDA/national primary crop releases; do not recount mill allocation

requirements.requirement: current food use, ethanol offtake and destination imports
requirements.policy: primary customs/industry data; separate realised use from mandates and announced purchases

requirements.requirement: current dated export quotas/bans, biofuel mandates and verified rerouting
requirements.policy: primary government/customs evidence with effective date and expiry; bridge to globally accessible supply

requirements.requirement: current marginal cash-cost and ethanol/export-parity range
requirements.policy: primary farm/mill costs and lawful energy/FX inputs; separate observed price, model range and market expectation
